items.title: Rotate and scale the scenario's icon offset
items.description: The icon from the scenario sits 40px right, 20px up from its hover pivot. Drag the angle and scale sliders to see exactly where that point lands — at the default 45° / 1.4×, this reproduces the unit's own rotate-then-scale numbers (≈59.4, 19.8).
items.compute: const rad = (params.angleDeg * Math.PI) / 180; const sx = 40 * params.scale; const sy = -20 * params.scale; const x = sx * Math.cos(rad) - sy * Math.sin(rad); const y = sx * Math.sin(rad) + sy * Math.cos(rad); return { x: Math.round(x * 10) / 10, y: Math.round(y * 10) / 10 };

items.title: Cosine similarity as the angle between two rating vectors changes
items.description: Two users' rating vectors point in directions that differ by some angle. Drag the angle to see how cosine similarity responds — 0° (identical taste) gives 1, 90° (unrelated) gives 0, and 180° (opposite taste) gives -1.
items.compute: const rad = (params.angleBetweenDeg * Math.PI) / 180; return { cosineSimilarity: Math.round(Math.cos(rad) * 1000) / 1000 };
